summary: Strengthened AGENT_SYSTEM prompt to prioritize positive expert signals over negative VQA consensus when high-res tools fail.

edits.hypothesis: Explicitly instructing the agent to prioritize positive findings from specialized expert models over negative consensus from general VQA models when high-resolution inspection fails will correct the systematic false negatives observed in tasks like q000001 and q000009.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The failure mode is a reasoning bias in how the agent weighs conflicting evidence; this requires a change in the system prompt's decision heuristic, not just code flow.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M-arm agents receiving the AGENT_SYSTEM prompt.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, chest_xray_expert said 'No' but ground truth was 'Yes'; however, in q000009, chest_xray_expert said 'Yes' while others said 'No'. The new rule would have prioritized the 'Yes' from the expert in q000009, leading to the correct answer. (preservative) Tasks where all models agree or no expert conflict exists are unaffected. (transfer) Generalizes to any domain where a specialized tool fails and a high-precision/low-recall expert conflicts with low-precision/high-recall generalists.
edits.regression_risk: May increase false positives if the specialized expert model hallucinates a positive finding, but this is preferred over missing subtle pathology in medical contexts.
edits.mechanism: Explicitly instructing the agent to prioritize positive findings from specialized expert models over negative consensus from general VQA models when high-resolution inspection fails will correct the systematic false negatives observed in tasks like q000001 and q000009.
